Khamoshi mein matlab milta.
Grit woh hai jo tum quit karne ke baad karte.
Grit rukavaton ko paar karti hai.
Perseverance first failure ke baad quitting nahi.
Grit mushkil mein bhi mehnat karne ki ability hai.
Courage i resistance to fear, mastery of fear—na absence of fear.
Grit namumkin ko mumkin banati hai.
Darpok baar baar marte hain.
Khamoshi ek bahut badi taakat ka zariya hai.
Sahanashilta mahan hoti hai.
Khamoshi ko agyaanta aur shaanti ko swikaar mat samjho.
Taqat aur khamoshi dost hain.
Apni yojnaon ko raat jaisi dark aur impenetrable rakho, aur jab move karo to bijli ki tarah girna.
Aage badhte raho.
Humein brothers jaise saath rehna seekhna chahiye—warna fools ki tarah saath perish.
Aantarik shaanti se badi koi taakat nahi hoti.
Jo tumhe impossible lagta—wo kaam tumhe karna padega.
